name: requestId
label: Request ID
description: An ID to identify the request sent for fetching the list data.

name: rowDefinitions
label: Row definitions
description: Contains data associated with the rendering of each row and all of its cells

name: columnDefinitions
label: Column Definitions
description: Contains data associated with rendering table headers as well as configuration for cells within this column

name: enableOmitCount
label: Omit count record
description: When the omit count property is enabled, it sets this flag to true, indicating that the list header record count and pagination row count should be hidden

name: page
label: Current Page
description: The index of the current page

name: rowLimit
label: Row Limit
description: The max number of rows to show per page

name: model
label: Deprecated List Model
description: DEPRECATED: Returns the legacy list model for backwards compatability. Please use the other properties for accessing the list data.
